d: Times Music presents the captivating Punjabi track "Perfect" by Gurinder Rai, featuring superstar rapper Badshah and the stunning Swaalina. This powerful collaboration blends smooth vocals, signature rap swagger, and visual elegance into one unforgettable experience. Gurinder Rai’s soulful voice sets the emotional tone, while Badshah delivers his trademark punchy rap verses that add depth and attitude. Swaalina, known for her striking presence in top Punjabi music videos, lights up the screen, making Perfect as visually compelling as it is musically addictive.
